Prompts

```
['run the CLI tool to generate cropped image pairs from a crop list file with multiprocessing', 'run load_crop_file to parse a crop list file and return image pairs with crop rectangles', 'run prepare_jobs to organize image pairs into jobs with hex-based subdirectory paths for output', 'run save_image_crops to crop, resize, and rotate image pairs then save them to disk', 'run load_image to open an image file and convert it to RGB color space']
```
